text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-paragraph argument with conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is organized into clear paragraphs with an introduction, supporting body paragraphs, and a conclusion that make the line of thought easy to follow."},{"evidence":"friend example and teacher example","quality":"support development","description":"The essay develops its points with multiple relevant examples and brief anecdotes rather than relying on repetition or unsupported claims."},{"evidence":"\"I have a friend who live...\" \"I was not a timid girl...\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay adds explanation and detail to extend ideas, showing more sustained development of each point."},{"evidence":"\"Most of students live with so much stress\"","quality":"academic vocabulary","description":"The essay uses more formal school-related wording such as stress, motivate, creative, sociable, and future to express ideas in a more academic register."},{"evidence":"connected explanations across paragraphs","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay uses transitions and referential connections to link ideas across sentences and paragraphs more effectively."}]}
